Garlic Chicken Wings

You don’t need to wait to go to a restaurant to enjoy delicious chicken wings. With this Kissan recipe, it can now be a scrumptious tiffin meal for you kid!

10 minPreparation
20 minCooking
4Servings

Ingredients

For 4 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Melt the butter in a pan. Add the garlic and cook until light brown.
  2. Stir in the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and cook for 2 minutes
  3. Add the Tabasco sauce and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
  4. Add the chicken wings and egg and mix well to coat the wings. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.
  5. Heat the oil in a pan. Roll the wings in the breadcrumbs and fry them till golden. Drain on absorbent paper.
  6. Then pour your prepared sauce over the cooked chicken wings and toss for 2 mins.
  7. Heat any remaining marinade in a small pan and pour over the wings.
